subject: Ecosystem roadshow & content exchange — BrightBridge partnership
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
To: BrightBridge Partnerships <partnerships@brightbridge.com>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 18 Nov 2026 15:12:00 -0800
Subject: Ecosystem roadshow & content exchange — BrightBridge partnership

Hi Lena / BrightBridge team,

Great meeting last month — thanks again for walking us through your partner enablement playbook. We left the conversation excited about a lightweight, regional "ecosystem roadshow" together (a mix of short in-person meetups + live panel webinars) to surface joint customer stories and tooling integration examples.

Basic idea: Redwood and BrightBridge co-produce a short content series across three months: (1) two localized meetups (SF, London), (2) two 45-min webinars (technical + business tracks), and (3) a shared blog spotlight + customer quote sets. We’ll lean on our field teams to drive attendance; you folks bring channel invites and a practitioner's POV.

Quick asks from our side to scope:
- Do you have local BD contacts in SF / London who can help secure small venues?
- Any restrictions on co-branded sponsorship messaging?
- Would BrightBridge be able to supply 1-2 customer references willing to do a 15-min fireside?

I attached a one-pager that sketches timelines and roles. If this looks promising, can we schedule a 30-min sync next week to map responsibilities and a tentative calendar? Calendly: https://calendly.com/jonas-weber/30m

Thanks — excited to partner on something modest but repeatable.

Best,
Jonas Weber
Head of Partnerships | Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0129
Redwood Inference

Attachment: redwood-ecosystem-roadshow-onepager.pdf (PDF, 140KB)
From: Lena Park <lena@brightbridge.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Tom Riley <tom@prworks.io>
Date: Thu, 19 Nov 2026 09:04:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Ecosystem roadshow & content exchange — BrightBridge partnership

Thanks Jonas — love the one-pager and the cadence. We’re definitely interested. A few quick notes from our side:

- SF / London local BD: yes, Sara Kim (SF) and Daniel Hargreaves (London) can help with venue logistics and local invite lists. I’ll intro them once we have dates.
- Messaging: BrightBridge legal asked that we avoid product claims comparing vendors — we can do co-branded case studies and technical panels, but keep any performance claims to customer quotes.
- Customers: we have a retail customer in the UK who used your embeddings workflow in a POC and would be open to a short fireside — I’ll check availability.

Couple of asks back at you:
1) Can Redwood provide a short technical demo template (15 min) that highlights integrations with BrightBridge tooling?
2) Do you have a rough budget for venue sponsorships / catering?

I looped Tom from our PR agency since they often help amplify event content. If we can align on a shared calendar, PR can coordinate pre/post event blogs and social.

Best,
Lena Park
Head of Partnerships | BrightBridge
lena@brightbridge.com

Great — thanks Lena. A couple of practical notes from events/field ops:

- Venue size: aim for 60-100 pax for SF and 50-80 for London to keep it conversational. Small venue cost estimate: $2.5k–$6k depending on AV/catering.
- Speaker slots: propose 3 short talks + a 30-min panel. One slot reserved for a customer fireside.
- Demo template: Jonas / Eng can share a 15-min walkthrough; we should keep it deeply practical (code snippets, architecture diagram, integration checklist).

I attached a proposed guest list CSV with categories (enterprise, ISV, press). This will help prioritize invites.

Next steps I’d propose:
1) Quick internal alignment call (30 min) next Tue 11/24 — finalize ask pool and speakers.
2) Draft the co-branded event page and one-pager for approvals.

Camila
Senior Field Events Manager | Redwood Inference

Thanks all — this is shaping up nicely. Quick notes from demand/gen / content:

- Co-branded content: we can do a blog swap (BrightBridge publishes a guest post on your customer automation work; Redwood publishes a BrightBridge integration deep-dive). We’ll syndicate to our newsletter and use paid social for market testing.
- Lead sharing: we’ll agree on a joint MQL handoff window (48 hours) and a simple UTM-based tracking plan. Legal will draft a brief mutual MSA addendum for lead sharing.
- Creative: can PR / field ops agree on final images by Dec 3 so we have event pages live by Dec 10?

Sergio — can you and your team put together the demo template Jonas mentioned (15-min, includes integration checklist + minimal code snippet)? Will need it by Nov 30.
